reason: 21,000 in fees on a 30,000 pair of shoes is almost doubling the price, and the things I want are small cheap items where 13,000 a kilo eats all the saving. I can find similar stuff on Instagram pages or Shein for less once I compare.
objection: The per-kilo shipping makes cheap items not worth it, and I would be paying up front to a brand new page I don't know, after my cousin lost her deposit to a page that disappeared.
would_change_my_mind: A much lower shipping rate or a free-shipping minimum for light items, plus paying everything only on delivery so I don't risk money with a new page.
